````text
# #3287: Patch: the AI's board threat counts no hero hit from a Unit inside The Gauntlet
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The Gauntlet, a Stinkyscape Field Spell, makes the Units in the middle three lanes fight only each other: none of them may attack a hero. The AI knows this when it looks for a lethal attack. It does not know it when it judges how dangerous a board is.

Say The Gauntlet is up and the enemy has three 4/4s in the middle lanes. An AI at 10 health then believes it faces 12 damage. It switches its Units to Defense and makes desperate trades against damage that cannot land. When the AI plays The Gauntlet itself, it never sees the wall it has built.

Once this is built, the AI counts those attacks as unable to reach the hero.

## Why

- `face_threat_with` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:908-927`) pushes every ready unit's attacks with `true` as "may hit the hero" (line 924). Its comment reasons only about summoning sickness.
- The engine refuses a hero attack from a Unit in `GAUNTLET_LANES` while The Gauntlet acts (`crates/engine/src/restrictions.rs:214-220`, R1849005; S #157 in `spec/08-catalog.md:752`).
- The lethal search already reads it: `may_hit_hero` (`crates/ai/src/lethal.rs:153-160`) calls `attack_restriction` against the hero. #1974 (7b1304ea92) fixed the lethal gap and left `face_threat` alone, and "gauntlet" appears nowhere in `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`.
- `face_threat` feeds the evaluation's threat and pressure terms (`lethal_threat` among them), `wall_switches` (`crates/ai/src/candidates.rs:962-990`) and the learned features.
- In the sweep's watch list, S #157 was played once on 13 affordable turns (`crates/ai/src/shadow_ban.rs:744-745`).

## Proposal

- In `face_threat_with`, set each attack's third field from `attack_restriction(state, unit, &AttackTarget::Hero { player: attacker.opponent() }).is_ok()`, the read `may_hit_hero` already makes.
- Put it behind an `EvalWeights` flag that is on in `AI_EVAL` and off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, so the greedy yardstick stays frozen, as the AI's other new terms are.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` and `crates/ai/src/config.rs`.
- A threat test under `crates/ai/tests/ai/`.
- The line on `face_threat` in `crates/ai/README.md`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A test: with The Gauntlet acting and the enemy's ready Units only in lanes 2 to 4, `face_threat` is 0 and `wall_switches` offers no stand-down.
- [ ] A test: with one of those Units in lane 1 instead, its attack counts.
- [ ] A test: without The Gauntlet, `face_threat` is unchanged on the existing fixtures.
- [ ] `GREEDY_EVAL` is unchanged, and `cargo jackioh gate` passes at smoke size.

## Size and risks

Small: about 20 lines plus tests.

Risks:
- It changes the AI's decisions only in games where The Gauntlet is on the field.
- The three matchup gates cannot see one card, so S #157's sweep row is the measure.
- If `crates/ai/README.md` requires it for an evaluation change, the AI's generation is bumped.

//! The Gauntlet (S #157) in the AI's threat (#3287): while it acts, a Unit in its lanes may attack no hero
//! (R1849005, `attack_restriction`), so `face_threat` counts none of its attacks and `wall_switches` offers

use jackioh_ai::*;
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;

use super::support::{AI, HUMAN, register_cards, unit};

const GAUNTLET: &str = "stinkyscape-157";
const BIG: &str = "core-025";
const VANILLA: &str = "core-008";

/// AI_EVAL with the Gauntlet read off: every unit that may swing counts, as before #3287.
const OFF: EvalWeights = EvalWeights {
    gauntlet_bars_face_attacks: false,
    ..AI_EVAL
};

/// The AI at `health` with the 7/7 in Attack Position in `big_lane`, against a 4/4 in each of `lanes`, and
/// The Gauntlet in `gauntlet`'s backrow (none with `None`).
fn board(gauntlet: Option<PlayerId>, health: i32, big_lane: i32, lanes: &[i32]) -> GameState {
    register_cards();
    let backrow = |seat: PlayerId| if gauntlet == Some(seat) { json!([GAUNTLET]) } else { json!([]) };
    let enemies: Vec<Value> = lanes.iter().map(|lane| json!({ "def": VANILLA, "lane": lane })).collect();
    scenario(json!({
        "seed": "ai-gauntlet",
        "p1": { "health": health, "field": [{ "def": BIG, "lane": big_lane }], "backrow": backrow(AI) },
        "p2": { "field": enemies, "backrow": backrow(HUMAN) },
    }))
    .state()
    .clone()
}

/// The 7/7's switch to Defense Position.
fn wall(state: &GameState) -> ActionBody {
    ActionBody::SwitchPosition { instance_id: unit(state, AI, BIG).id.clone() }
}

/// The walls the AI is offered on `state`.
fn walls(state: &GameState) -> Vec<ActionBody> {
    wall_switches(state, AI, &candidate_actions(state, AI, Prices::NONE))
}
```
````
